hero.title: Simple. Secure. Built Right.
hero.subtitle: OneDroid transforms ideas into intelligent mobile experiences. We combine innovative technology, purposeful design, and on-device intelligence to build apps that solve real problems and redefine everyday possibilities.

approach.title: Open Source
approach.text: Selected apps and libraries are built in the open on GitHub. Read the code, report issues, and contribute.

approach.title: Free with Ads
approach.text: Many of our apps are free to download and supported by ads, kept unobtrusive so they stay out of your way.

approach.title: In-App Purchases
approach.text: Optional upgrades unlock premium features or remove ads. Always clearly priced, never required to get started.

approach.title: Privacy First
approach.text: Whatever the model, each app collects only what it needs and explains it plainly in its privacy policy.

about.title: About OneDroid
about.description: OneDroid is an independent mobile app studio building simple, secure, and genuinely useful Android apps. Some are open source, some are free with ads and in-app purchases.

sections.title: (01) Who We Are
content: OneDroid is a startup focused on modern Android development. We design, build, and ship apps that solve everyday problems with clean interfaces, solid performance, and careful attention to detail.

sections.title: (02) How We Build
content: Not every app follows the same model. Some of our projects are fully open source: their code lives on GitHub, where anyone can review it, learn from it, or contribute. Others are free to download and supported by ads, with optional in-app purchases for premium features or an ad-free experience.
This mix lets us share what we can with the community while earning the revenue that keeps a small studio sustainable, so our apps stay maintained, updated, and supported for the long term.

sections.title: (03) Our Promise
content: Whatever the business model, the standard stays the same: apps that respect your time and your device. Ads are kept unobtrusive, purchases are optional and clearly priced, and each app collects only what it needs, explained plainly in its privacy policy.

sections.title: (04) Founder
content: OneDroid was founded and is led by Tawhid Monowar, who drives the product vision and engineering. He designs, builds, and maintains the apps, from the first line of code to every release on Google Play.
